title: RETRO_VHS_Screen
description: A minecraft styled vhs shader for horror modpacks, with flickering rec, and some more cool things.
body: Hi this is my first modrinth project. This shader is a minecraft vhs shader that adds many cool vhs features! Perfect for alpha/beta styled modpacks or mods. If you are intrested in it, try it! Let me know, if you liked it in the comments!
